entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I hope you can help me. I'm calling about a return. I bought a helmet a little while ago and I... I just can't keep it. I feel terrible about it.
I'm sorry to hear that, but I can certainly look into it for you. Do you have the order number available?
Yes, it's VF-886-3021. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really needed this money for something else that's come up unexpectedly. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it.

I appreciate your loyalty, and I'll do my best to help. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Stratus Pro Helmet, delivered on November 19th. To make sure I understand the situation, is it a technical fault with the item or more of a preference issue?

Oh, it's just a preference. There's nothing wrong with the helmet itself. In fact, the box is still unopened. I just saw the color through the little window on the packaging and it wasn't what I had pictured. It's a silly reason, I know, but things are just tight right now.

It's not silly at all. Being comfortable with your gear is important, especially with something like a helmet where personal safety is key. Let me just confirm the return policy for this item. One moment please.

Alright, I have good news. Because this is a standard VeloFit item, it's covered by our 90-day return policy. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund.
Really? Oh, that is such a huge relief! Thank you so much, Diana. I was so stressed about this. You have no idea what a help that is.

Of course. I've just emailed a pre-paid shipping label to you. And since I see here that you're one of our VIP members, I've also added a 15% off coupon to your account for your next order, as a thank you for your continued loyalty to VeloFit.
Wow, you didn't have to do that. That's incredibly kind. Thank you again for everything.
It's my pleasure. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that was it. You've been wonderful. Have a great day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
